subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: suddenly a voice called out good morning gentlemen where are you going and what are you doing here oh nowhere and nothing but you look so pensive why yes you are right we are looking for something replied the six blind men Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation "Porter, you may go," said the mistress of the house laughing. "You have gained your freedom." "By Allah," he replied, "I won't leave the house." Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 199
